Federal taxable income = 225,010.00 - 15,750.00 standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 for 65 or older = 207,260.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 1040ME, single: line 14 federal AGI 225,010.00. Line 16 Maine AGI = 225,010.00 + 0.00 - 20,000.00 = 205,010.00. Line 17 (person 0 born 1959-02-10 is 66 at December 31, 2025; 1 box(es)): Worksheet for Standard/Itemized Deductions (PDF p.5): line 1 205,010.00; line 2 100,000.00; line 3 105,010.00; line 4 75,000.00; line 5 = 1.400133..., one or more, so 1.0000; line 6 chart amount 17,000.00; line 7 = 17,000.00 x 1.0000 = 17,000.00; line 8 = 0.00. Projection (share kept 1 - 1.0000 = 0.0000): base 15,000.00 x 0.0000 = 0.00 + additional 65-or-over 1 x 2,000.00 x 0.0000 = 0.00 = 0.00, the same. Line 17 = 0.00. Line 13 = 1; line 18 exemption = 1 x 5,150.00 = 5,150.00 (Maine AGI not over 333,450.00). Line 19 taxable income = 205,010.00 - 0.00 - 5,150.00 = 199,860.00. Line 20 tax from the rate schedule (PDF p.13): 5.8% x (26,800.00 - 0.00) = 1,554.40 + 6.75% x (63,450.00 - 26,800.00) = 2,473.875 + 7.15% x (199,860.00 - 63,450.00) = 9,753.315 = 13,781.59. The printed schedule (PDF p.13) with its whole-dollar constant 4,028.00 gives 13,781.32; expected keeps the bracket tax computed in full. Line 23 nonrefundable credits 0.00; line 24 Maine income tax 13,781.59. Military retirement pay (P9) is not phased out: it is exempt in full while the non-military deduction is gone.
accepted_approximations: Tax is computed from the rate schedules as numbers. The booklet's table taxes 100-dollar rows and the printed schedule constants are rounded to dollars.
